jQuery(document).ready(function () {
  $("#reader").click(function (params) {
    $("#pane").removeClass("hidden");
    let file = $(".pdf-dl").attr("href");
    jQuery(".pdf-flip-container").flipBook({
      pdfUrl: file,
      assets: {
        preloader: "/site/templates/scripts/assets/images/preloader.jpg",
        overlay: "/site/templates/scripts/assets/images/overlay.png",
        flipMp3: "/site/templates/scripts/assets/mp3/turnPage.mp3",
        spinner: "/site/templates/scripts/assets/images/spinner.gif",
        backgroundMp3: "/site/templates/scripts/assets/mp3/background.mp3",
      },
    });
  });
});
